name: C6, the user's chart
note: The user's own C6 copedent, read cell by cell from their chart (chart = the sheet's column and its notes; the sheet numbers these pedals 4-8). tools/export_rig.py draws from this file and motor_ctrl's table is compiled from it. moves: string number (1 = highest, string N = index + 1) -> semitones at full travel, signed. slot: the lever board's slot on bus B (lever.h); 0-4 pedals left to right, 5-10 knee levers left to right from the seat. Slot 10 is the sixth knee lever, which this copedent does not use yet.
